anchor.guidance: Mgmt FY27: revenue Rs 14,000 Cr (+42% vs FY26); defence >Rs 4,500 Cr (>30% mix); EBITDA margin ~27-28%

logic: Base 22% CAGR tracks Rs 14,000 Cr FY27 guide then sustains on Pinaka execution + international explosives scale-up, margins held near 28%.
Bear = defence execution slips + explosives volumes stall + derate to 30x. Bull = defence >Rs 4,500 Cr early + export defence orders + P/E held at 60x.
Key insight: EPS spread 262.6 -> 884.7 (~3.4x) is smaller than price spread 7,854 -> 53,026 (~6.8x) — the multiple does the heavy lifting.
Monitor quarterly: defence revenue vs Rs 4,500 Cr guide, order inflows, OPM vs 28%, WC/inventory days, Pinaka dispatch pace, export growth.

takeaway: Solar Industries doesn't sell explosives — it sells assured destruction on schedule where mining and militaries can't wait, and the filings say the next chapter is Rs 4,500 Cr of defence revenue plus a Rs 21,350 Cr order book plus Rs 2,050 Cr of capex — mixed in Nagpur, fired worldwide, priced for a straight-line execution.

big_messages: Rs 14,000 Cr FY27 revenue guide (+42%) with defence crossing Rs 4,500 Cr and 30% mix
Rs 21,350 Cr order book (~1.9x TTM sales) with sizeable new orders expected in coming quarters
Q1FY27 beat every record (sales, EBITDA, PAT) with 27.9% margins — scale without margin dilution
red_flags: Steep premium ~87x P/E, 28.4x P/B, 15.7x P/S — AlphaSpread multiples model -67%
Defence execution concentration — Rs 18,000 Cr book (~84%); Pinaka dispatches began only Q4FY26; quarterly mix swings
Working-capital load 74 days (from 37); CCC 152 days; inventory 130 days on deliberate stockpiling
Capex + leverage uptick — Rs 2,050 Cr FY27 capex; borrowings Rs 975→1,524 Cr; FCF Rs -1,072 Cr; CFO Rs 621 Cr vs PAT Rs 1,737 Cr
Lumpiness + thin disclosure — single reportable segment; Coal India/export timing drives quarters
trends: Defence scale-up — Rs 933 Cr Q1 (+123% YoY); Pinaka commercial dispatches from Q4FY26
International explosives surge — Rs 1,364 Cr Q1 (+65% YoY); Turkey/Kazakhstan/Australia capacity
Order-book cover — Rs 21,350 Cr (~1.9x TTM); defence Rs 18,000 Cr implies Rs 4,000-4,500 Cr/yr visibility
Margin defence — 27.9% Q1 EBITDA on favourable defence + export mix and leverage
Capex/WC cycle — Rs 2,050 Cr capex + deliberate inventory; normalisation over 2 quarters guided

valuation.methodology: AlphaSpread primary live 30 Sep 2026 — DCF Rs 20,788.08 (Net Income template, 15yr, Rev 17.3% vs 5Y hist 31.4%, Net margin 17.9%->16.7% vs hist 13.8%, Discount 11.1%, Exit 31.5x P/E) + Multiples-Based Rs 6,488.13 -> equal-weight blended Rs 13,638, Buy Rs 10,910. Local cross-check: trailing ~87x, EV/EBITDA ~58x on op Rs 3,101 Cr TTM, P/B 28.4x, OPM ~28%.
